Organic.guidance: Separate from dry waste and compost where possible.
Organic.sakhi_says: Add this to your wet/organic waste or local composting system.

profile_notes.Apartment: Consider collective/community composting for the whole building.
profile_notes.Apartment Association: Consider collective/community composting for the whole community.

Recyclable.guidance: Keep clean and dry before collection.
Recyclable.sakhi_says: Rinse if needed, keep it dry, and hand it over with dry/recyclable waste.

profile_notes.default: Hand over with dry waste to your recycler or waste collector.

Hazardous.bin: Do not place in normal household waste
Hazardous.guidance: Store separately and do not dismantle. Route to a hazardous-waste collection point.
Hazardous.sakhi_says: Do not mix this with general waste or try to open it. Keep it aside for specialized collection.

profile_notes.default: Store separately and request specialized collection.
profile_notes.Chemical Industry: Follow your statutory hazardous-waste manifest and authorized handler process.
profile_notes.Large Industry: Route through your authorized hazardous-waste handler.

E-Waste.bin: Do not place in normal household waste
E-Waste.guidance: Store separately and route to an appropriate e-waste collector. Do not dismantle.
E-Waste.sakhi_says: Do not mix this with general waste. Keep it aside for an authorized e-waste collector.

profile_notes.default: Store separately and route to an authorized e-waste collector.
profile_notes.Electrical Industry: Route through your authorized e-waste / EPR channel.
profile_notes.Office: Maintain an e-waste register and hand over to an authorized collector.

Biomedical.guidance: Do not mix with general municipal waste.
Biomedical.sakhi_says: Do not handle casually or mix this with general waste. Use a specialized biomedical stream.

profile_notes.default: Potential biomedical/sharp waste. Do not handle casually. Seek appropriate local disposal guidance.
profile_notes.Clinic: Biomedical waste detected. Follow the clinic's designated sharps/biomedical segregation workflow.
profile_notes.Hospital: Route through the organization's biomedical waste-management workflow.

General.guidance: Only items that cannot be composted or recycled should go here. Reduce and reuse first.
General.sakhi_says: If it cannot be composted, recycled or specially handled, it goes in residual waste.

profile_notes.default: Place in the residual waste bin.
